functions.definition: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION append_product_base_price_history() RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $function$ BEGIN IF TG_OP = 'INSERT' THEN INSERT INTO product_price_history (tenant_id, product_id, price_id, amount_cents, effective_from) VALUES (NEW.tenant_id, NEW.id, NULL, NEW.price_cents, NEW.created_at); ELSIF NEW.price_cents IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.price_cents THEN INSERT INTO product_price_history (tenant_id, product_id, price_id, amount_cents, effective_from) VALUES ( NEW.tenant_id, NEW.id, NULL, NEW.price_cents, to_char(clock_timestamp() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.MS"Z"') ); END IF; RETURN NEW; END; $function$
functions.name: append_product_base_price_history

functions.definition: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION append_product_price_history() RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $function$ BEGIN IF TG_OP = 'INSERT' THEN INSERT INTO product_price_history (tenant_id, product_id, price_id, amount_cents, effective_from) VALUES (NEW.tenant_id, NEW.product_id, NEW.id, NEW.amount_cents, NEW.created_at); ELSIF NEW.amount_cents IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.amount_cents THEN INSERT INTO product_price_history (tenant_id, product_id, price_id, amount_cents, effective_from) VALUES ( NEW.tenant_id, NEW.product_id, NEW.id, NEW.amount_cents, to_char(clock_timestamp() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.MS"Z"') ); END IF; RETURN NEW; END; $function$
functions.name: append_product_price_history

functions.definition: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION prevent_paid_order_billing_change() RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $function$ BEGIN IF OLD.status = 'paid' AND NEW.billing IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.billing THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'paid order billing snapshot is immutable'; END IF; RETURN NEW; END; $function$
functions.name: prevent_paid_order_billing_change
